# iCloud Calendar MCP

> An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI assistants read and change iCloud Calendar over CalDAV. It runs on the user's computer with Java 21 or newer, talks only to iCloud, and sends no telemetry. Free and open source under Apache-2.0. Made by OneKash Labs (https://onekash.org). Not affiliated with Apple.

Full text for AI assistants: https://mcp.onekash.org/llms-full.txt

## Get it

- npm: `npx @icloud-calendar-mcp/server` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@icloud-calendar-mcp/server)
- PyPI: `uvx icloud-calendar-mcp` (https://pypi.org/project/icloud-calendar-mcp/)
- JAR: https://github.com/icloud-calendar-mcp/icloud-calendar-mcp/releases/latest
- Also on the MCP Registry.

## Docs

- [Setup guide](https://mcp.onekash.org/#setup): Java 21, an app-specific password, and the client configuration.
- [Full reference](https://github.com/icloud-calendar-mcp/icloud-calendar-mcp#readme): every tool parameter, recurring-event scopes, alarms, and troubleshooting.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/icloud-calendar-mcp/icloud-calendar-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Source code](https://github.com/icloud-calendar-mcp/icloud-calendar-mcp)
